title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Reveals Final Battle Visual Ahead of Last Anime Episode
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War has revealed a new “THE STORIES VISUAL – Final Battle” visual following the premiere of Episode 49, “THE BLADE.” The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25, before delaying the final two episodes to improve quality .
author: Anime Corner

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at a Major Flashback
content: Black Clover Season 2 is now working its way through the Fall 2026 anime season, and the first look preview images for Episode 4 of the series are teasing Nacht and Yami’s major flashback.
author: ComicBook

title: EST N8 Picks Up Korean-Animated Film Pilgrims for Worldwide Sales
content: EST N8, an American entertainment company, announced on October 8 it has acquired worldwide sales rights to Pilgrims , a Korean science-fiction animated feature that screened at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival and won a technical award at the 2025 Bucheon International Animation Festival (BIAF).
author: ANN

title: Netflix Power Rangers Reboot Costumes Finally Revealed & Fans Are Relieved “Glad This Was Cancelled”
content: The Power Rangers franchise is current in limbo as its multiple reboot attempts have unfortunately not made it beyond the development stage, but with the concept art revealed for what is likely Netflix’s take on the franchise, fans are glad to see that it was ultimately cancelled.
author: ComicBook

title: Comic CMOA Service Remains Suspended After Confirmed Unauthorized External Access
content: The service announced the emergency maintenance on Thursday morning, and gave an update that evening that there was a high likelihood of an unauthorized external access to its servers. The service confirmed on Friday the unauthorized external access to its servers, resulting to information leakage of some its members.
author: ANN

title: Rakuten Viki, Imaginus to Debut AI-Assisted Korean-Animated Series The Painted Soul on October 21
content: Rakuten Viki announced on October 9 that it will premiere The Painted Soul , a 10-episode animated series co-produced with South Korean production company Imaginus, exclusively on its platform on October 21 in select international markets.
author: ANN
